claude-agent.title: B7 inverted: allowlisted keys are rate-limited while all non-allowlisted keys bypass enforcement via the else branch returning Ok(true).
B1 off-by-one: `events.len() <= self.limit` admits the limit+1-th event instead of denying it; should be `<`.
B5 default-mismatch: DEFAULT_BURST is 80 but the intent specifies a default burst of 8.
B6 violated: a malformed `rate` value is silently replaced with DEFAULT_RATE via unwrap_or instead of being rejected as ConfigError::Malformed.
B8 violated: TokenBucket::new never checks for zero refill_interval_ms, so refill later divides by zero (panic) and ConfigError::ZeroInterval is unreachable.
B2 violated: `ticks * self.refill_rate` is an unchecked u32 multiply that can overflow (panic in debug, wrap in release).
B2 violated: `self.tokens + owed` can overflow u32 before the `.min(capacity)` clamp is applied; addition must saturate.
B3 violated: deposit saturating_adds tokens without clamping to capacity, allowing token count to exceed capacity.
B4 violated: stats_for indexes self.shards[shard] directly, panicking on an out-of-range shard instead of returning None.
B2 violated: `(elapsed / self.refill_interval_ms) as u32` truncates for large elapsed time, silently losing tick value instead of saturating.
The keys HashMap inserts a KeyState per distinct key with no eviction, growing without bound under many caller-supplied keys.
